game.source: crates/voxelgame-core/src/inventory.rs RECIPES, with inventory/cooking.rs and inventory/door_recipes.rs

recipes.name: Split alder boards
recipes.gameDescription: Split one alder log piece into four board pieces
recipes.notes: Counts are half-metre pieces: one full 1 m log block (8 pieces) splits into 32 boards.

recipes.name: Split birch boards
recipes.gameDescription: Split one birch log piece into four pale board pieces

recipes.name: Split pine boards
recipes.gameDescription: Split one pine log piece into four resinous board pieces

recipes.name: Split oak boards
recipes.gameDescription: Split one oak log piece into four grey-brown board pieces

recipes.name: Split fruitwood boards
recipes.gameDescription: Split one fruitwood log piece into four rosy board pieces

recipes.name: Split acacia boards
recipes.gameDescription: Split one acacia log piece into four bright orange board pieces

recipes.name: Split willow boards
recipes.gameDescription: Split one willow log piece into four pale board pieces

recipes.name: Split mangrove boards
recipes.gameDescription: Split one mangrove log piece into four deep red board pieces

recipes.name: Split jungle boards
recipes.gameDescription: Split one jungle log piece into four olive-brown board pieces

recipes.name: Split cherry boards
recipes.gameDescription: Split one cherry log piece into four red-brown board pieces

recipes.name: Split giant boards
recipes.gameDescription: Split one giant log piece into four rust-red board pieces

recipes.name: Split palm boards
recipes.gameDescription: Split one palm log piece into four streaked board pieces

recipes.name: Split mesquite boards
recipes.gameDescription: Split one mesquite log piece into four dark board pieces

recipes.name: Split fig boards
recipes.gameDescription: Split one fig log piece into four cream board pieces

recipes.name: Split cypress boards
recipes.gameDescription: Split one cypress log piece into four golden board pieces

recipes.name: Split deadwood boards
recipes.gameDescription: Split one dry deadwood piece into four plain alder-like boards
recipes.notes: Makes plain Alder boards. Driftwood, Charred log and Mossy log have no splitting recipe.

recipes.name: Burn a charcoal pile
recipes.gameDescription: Smoulder four board pieces into two cooking or kiln fuels

recipes.name: Cook raw meat
recipes.gameDescription: Grills a raw cut over charcoal into filling cooked meat
recipes.notes: Raw meat restores 8 hunger, Cooked meat 30. A placed {{cooking-stove|cooking stove}} cooks the same recipe.

recipes.name: Roast venison
recipes.gameDescription: Roasts lean venison over charcoal for a full meal
recipes.notes: One Venison (18 hunger raw) becomes 2 Cooked meat (30 each). A placed {{cooking-stove|cooking stove}} cooks the same recipe.

recipes.name: Blow glass flasks
recipes.gameDescription: Two empty flasks; press T at fresh water to fill them
recipes.notes: 8 Glass pieces = one full glass block. Fill flasks by pressing T near drinkable water.

recipes.name: Fire glass
recipes.gameDescription: Fires sand over charcoal into clear building glass
recipes.notes: 3 blocks of Sand make 2 blocks of Glass. Only Sand works (not Sea, Dune, Red, Black or Shell sand). Besides this recipe, the Survey workshop landmark's one-time find gives 8 Glass.

recipes.name: Kiln-fire gray brick
recipes.gameDescription: Bakes clay into hard courtyard brick
recipes.notes: No kiln block exists; craft it from the pack.

recipes.name: Glaze roof tile
recipes.gameDescription: Glazes clay with sand ash into weatherproof roof tile

recipes.name: Glaze pink roof tile
recipes.gameDescription: Fires clay under a heavy petal glaze into deep pink roof tile

recipes.name: Burn lime plaster
recipes.gameDescription: Burns limestone into smooth whitewashed plaster
recipes.notes: Only Limestone counts (Sharp limestone does not).

recipes.name: Tint pink plaster
recipes.gameDescription: Works a few crushed wildflowers into lime plaster for soft pink walls

recipes.name: Dress carved stone
recipes.gameDescription: Dress any natural stone into fine building stone
inputs: Natural stone (any of 26 natural stones; mixable)

recipes.name: Cut sandstone
recipes.gameDescription: Compacts two blocks of loose sand into one of sandstone

recipes.name: Lacquer timber
recipes.gameDescription: Seals boards with fired clay lacquer for structural beams

recipes.name: Paint pink boards
recipes.gameDescription: Stains alder boards pink with a wildflower paint

recipes.name: Weave paper panel
recipes.gameDescription: Presses shore reeds into a board-latticed screen panel
recipes.notes: Only Reeds count (Tall reeds do not).

recipes.name: Assemble red lantern
recipes.gameDescription: A charcoal-lit paper lantern; it lights its room without refuelling
recipes.notes: Makes half a block of lantern (4 pieces).

recipes.name: Weave reed thatch
recipes.gameDescription: Bind reeds with plant fiber or wool for warm roofing
recipes.notes: Plant fiber comes from Wild flax. Raw reeds cannot stand in for the binding.

recipes.name: Dress chalk bricks
recipes.gameDescription: Cuts pale chalk into masonry blocks

recipes.name: Dress red rock bricks
recipes.gameDescription: Cuts red rock into warm-colored masonry

recipes.name: Dress basalt bricks
recipes.gameDescription: Cuts volcanic basalt into dark masonry

recipes.name: Polish granite
recipes.gameDescription: Smooths coarse granite into a decorative building block
recipes.notes: Only Granite counts (Flaking granite does not).

recipes.name: Dress marble
recipes.gameDescription: Dresses limestone into white veined marble, whitened with a little chalk

recipes.name: Polish marble
recipes.gameDescription: Rubs marble smooth and bright with sand as the abrasive

recipes.name: Dress marble bricks
recipes.gameDescription: Cuts marble into dressed bricks for offset courses

recipes.name: Carve marble
recipes.gameDescription: Carves fluted column sides and a rosette panel into marble

recipes.name: Cover cobblestone with moss
recipes.gameDescription: Beds living moss into rough cobblestone for weathered walls

recipes.name: Stone sword
recipes.gameDescription: A dependable close-range survival weapon
inputs: Natural stone (any of 26 natural stones; mixable)
recipes.notes: Crafted tools are equipped automatically.

recipes.name: Stone pickaxe
recipes.gameDescription: The fastest tool for rock and crystal
inputs: Natural stone (any of 26 natural stones; mixable)

recipes.name: Stone hatchet
recipes.gameDescription: A broad cutting head for every timber species
inputs: Natural stone (any of 26 natural stones; mixable)
recipes.notes: The 4 starter boards plus 4 pieces of any natural stone, gravel included, make the first hatchet.

recipes.name: Stone shovel
recipes.gameDescription: A light digging tool for loose terrain
inputs: Natural stone (any of 26 natural stones; mixable)

recipes.name: Alder bow
recipes.gameDescription: A hunting bow bound with plant fiber or wool

recipes.name: Reed-bound bow
recipes.gameDescription: Twisted wetland reeds make a bowstring without animal drops
recipes.notes: Same Alder bow as the fiber or wool recipe, without animal drops.

recipes.name: Reed fishing rod
recipes.gameDescription: A plant-fiber line on a light reed-and-board rod

recipes.name: Four arrows
recipes.gameDescription: Stone-tipped arrows stabilized with feathers
inputs: Natural stone (any of 26 natural stones; mixable)

recipes.name: Four reed arrows
recipes.gameDescription: Reed shafts and vanes replace feathers for early hunting
inputs: Natural stone (any of 26 natural stones; mixable)

recipes.name: Four throwing rocks
recipes.gameDescription: Knapped hand stones; equip and hurl them at game
inputs: Natural stone (any of 26 natural stones; mixable)
recipes.notes: Each Throwing rock weighs 0.6 kg versus 0.125 kg per stone piece, so crafting rocks raises carried mass.

recipes.name: Alder rifle
recipes.gameDescription: A reed-bound stone and alder hunting rifle with automatic reload
inputs: Natural stone (any of 26 natural stones; mixable)
recipes.notes: 40 stone = 5 blocks, 16 boards = 2 blocks.

recipes.name: Four rifle rounds
recipes.gameDescription: Stone rifle shot with charcoal fuel and sand packing
inputs: Natural stone (any of 26 natural stones; mixable)

recipes.name: TNT
recipes.gameDescription: A bounded terrain-clearing charge ignited with G
recipes.notes: Makes one full TNT block (8 pieces) from 4 blocks of Sand, one block of Charcoal and one block of boards.

recipes.name: Two dynamite sticks
recipes.gameDescription: Repacks a charge into thrown sticks with paper casing
recipes.notes: Needs half a block of TNT (4 pieces).

recipes.name: Wooden door
recipes.gameDescription: A one-metre double door of framed boards; hang it on solid ground
recipes.notes: One block of boards. Any species can be mixed.

recipes.name: Wide wooden door
recipes.gameDescription: A two-metre folding double door for barns and halls
recipes.notes: Two blocks of boards. Any species can be mixed.

recipes.name: Wooden chest
recipes.gameDescription: A lidded board chest that keeps 250 kg of things where you set it down
recipes.notes: One block of boards.

recipes.name: Small sailing boat
recipes.gameDescription: A wooden dinghy with woven plant-fiber sails; launch on water
recipes.notes: Crafting selects the boat ready to launch; it weighs 18 kg.

recipes.name: Furniture hammer
recipes.gameDescription: Two board pieces and one natural stone piece make a carpentry tool
inputs: Natural stone (any of 26 natural stones; mixable)
recipes.notes: Carry it to use furniture plans in Survival.

recipes.name: Alder door
recipes.gameDescription: One leaf, one metre wide and two tall, made from these exact boards
recipes.notes: Only Alder boards count; other species do not, unlike the plain Wooden door.
